title: 12 Mathematics KCPE 2014
text:
THE KENYA NATIONAL EXAMNATION COUNCIL
 KCPE 2014
 250381
 MATHEMATICS Time:2 hour
 READ THESE INSTRUCTIONS CAREFULLY
 1. You have been given this questions booklet and separate answer sheet.The question booklet
 contain 50 questions
 2. Do any necessary rough work in this booklet.
 3. When you have chosen your answer,mark it on the ANSWER SHEET,not in this question booklet
 HOW TO USE THE ANSWER SHEET
 4. Use only ordinary pencil.
 5. Make sure that you have written on the answer sheet:
 YOUR INDEX NUMBER
 YOUR NAME
 NAME OF YOUR SCHOOL
 6. By drawing a dark line inside the correct numbered boxes mark your full Index Number (i.e
 School Code Number and the three figures Candidate”s Number)in the grid near the top of the
 answer sheet.
 7. Do not make any marks outside the boxes.
 8. Keep the sheet as clean as possible and do not fold it.
 9. For each of the question 1-50 four answers are given.The answers are lettered A.B,C and D.In
 each case only ONE of the four answers is correct.Choose the correct answer.
 10. On the answer sheet the correct answer is to be shown by drawing a dark line inside the box in
 which the latter have choosen is written.
 Example
 In the question booklet:
 11. What is the value of 6(24-18)+6x 4?
 A.30
 B.25
 C.10
 D28
 The correct answer is C (10)
 On the answer sheet:
 1 (A) (B) (C) (D) 11.(A) (B) (C) (D) 21. (A) (B) (C) (D
 In this set,the box with the letter D printed in it is marked.
 12. Your dark line MUST Be within the box.
 13. For each question ONLY ONE box is to be marked in each set of your boxes
 The Kenya National Examinations Council,2014
 K.C.P.E 2014 : MATHEMATICS
 DAY 1 : Time :2hrs
 1. In a certain country the population was 38898756.what was the population to the nearest
 ten thousand?
 A.38900000 B. 38890000
 C.3889000 D. 388900
 2. What is the largest 6-digit number written in words that can be formed using symbols
 4,2,0,8,3 and 6?
 A. Four hundred and twenty thousand eight hundred and thirty six
 B. Eight hundred and sixty four thousand three hundred and twenty
 C. Eight million and sixty four thousand three hundred and twenty
 D. Two hundred and three thousand four hundred and sixity eight
 3. What is the value of
 26 + 82 +62-56÷7×2?
 3+2
 4. In the number 3078642, the total value of the digit 7 is added to the total value of digit 4.
 Which is one of the following is the correct answer?
 A.70040 B.70004
 C. 7040 D.740
 5. What is the value of
 3/5 +1/4 (1/2 – 1/5 ) 0f 2/3 ÷1/3 ?

 C.37/60 D. ¾

 i) 22 ×32
 ii) 23 × 5
 iii) 24× 32

 A.4 B.30 C.180 D.720
 8. Which one of the following statements is correct?
 A. 0.27 is greater than 3/11
 B. 0.27 is equal to 3/11
 C. 3/11 is greater than 0.27
 D. 3/11 is less than 0.27.
 9. Which one of the following statements is true about the number of faces and the edges of the
 Square based pyramid?
 A. 5 faces and 5 edges
 B. 4 faces and 6 edges
 C. 5 faces and 8 edges
 D. 4 faces and 4 edges
 10. In a certain month a businessman made a profit of sh 8000. The following month his profit
 Was sh 12000. What was the percrntage increase of the profit?
 A. 66 2/3%
 B. 50%
 C.33 1/3% D. 20%
 11. A rectangular tank is 7.5m long,5m wide and 3.2m high.How many litres of water can
 Hold when full?
 A. 120
 B. 1200
 C. 12000
 D. 120 000

 X + 3 (x + 3)=23

 B. 8

 13. Tuku spent 1/3 of this money on school uniforms,1/4 on books,2/3 of the remainder on food
 and saved the rest.What total fraction of his money did he save and spend on books?
 A. 7/18
 B. 5/18
 C. 5/36
 D. 7/12
 14. Kerubo bought a T.V.set by paying a deposit of sh 2400plus 15 monthly instalments of 500
 each. The hire purchase price was 10% more than the marked price. What was the marked

 D. Sh 11 000

 i) Opposite sides are parallel
 ii) All sides are equal
 iii) Opposite angles are equal
 iv) Diagonals are unequal and bisect each other at right angles
 What is the name of the quadrilateral?
 A. Rectangle
 B. Trapezium
 C. Rhombus
 D. Square

 23. Below is a graph showing the journeys made by Bakari and Ouma. Both started at
 7.00am;Bakari started from town J to town K while Ouma started from town K to town J
 After travelling for 3 hours, Bakari rested for 30minutes, How far from town J was Ouma when
 Bakari started his rest?
 A. 300km
 B. 240km
 C. 180km
 D. 140km
 24. What is the value of 2x + 3y + 4z/(yz)2
 If x=2, y=x/2 and z =3y?

 π=22/7)
 A. 119.68
 B. 98.56
 C. 95.04
 D. 70.04
 26. Kebet left school by bicycle at 8.00am and took 1 ½ hours to reach the market 20km away.Akinyi
 left the school for the market by car at 8.30am.The average speed of the car was 80km/h.
 What was the difference between their arrival times?
 A. 1 hour 15 minutes
 B. 45 minutes
 C. 30 minutes
 D. 15 minutes
 27. Muli invested sh 10 000 in a bank which paid compound interest at the rate of 8% per annum.
 How much money did Muli have in the bank after two years,altogether?
 A. Sh 16 64
 B. Sh 11 600

 D. Sh 10 864

 36. A train left station P on Tuesday at 20 15 h and took 4 1/2 hours to reach town Q.On what time
 in am/pm system did the train arrive at station Q
 A. Wednesday 12.45am
 B. Wednesday 12.45pm
 C. Tuesday 12.45 am
 D. Tuesday 12.45 pm
 37. Maria bought 3 trays of eggs each containing 30 eggs. She paid sh 270 for each tray of eggs.
 Nine eggs were eaten at home and the rest were sold. If Maria made a profit of 20%, how much
 did she sell each egg?
 A. Sh 12.00
 B. Sh 10.80
 C. Sh 8.00
 38. The perimeter of a rectangular field is 56m. The length of one of its side is 7m. What is the area
 of the field?
 A. 392m2
 B. 294m2
 C. 171 1/2m2
 D. 147m2
 39. The total amount of milk produced by a certain cow in ten days was 115 litres. The daily produce
 in nine of the days was recorded in litres as 13,12,9,8,7,13,13 and 15. What was the median
 produce in the ten days?
 A. 13l
 B. 10l
 C. 11.5l
 D. 12.5l
 40. The number of people who visited a game park on Monday was 65, on Tuesday was 49 and on
 Wednesday was 58.On Thursday the number of people was 12 less than those who visited the
 game park on Friday was half the number that visited the game park on Saturday. A total of
 374 people visited the game park during the six days. How many people visited the game park
 on Friday?
 A. 104
 B. 78
 C. 52
 D. 44
